erratum.correction_1: dQ_LB/dtau_max = -k*Q_LB < 0, so TIGHTENING tau_max RAISES the bound and can only make certification EASIER; it can never create a new unsalable refusal. 'The payoff must come from a tighter tau' holds only for the usability meaning (fewer false refusals), not for discrimination.
erratum.correction_1_strengthened: tau_max = tw_end[0]-now is the LOOSEST SOUND duration bound and T_max = hard_upper is the HIGHEST SOUND temperature, so Q_LB is already the smallest value this FORM can soundly take. If it does not bind now, NO sound (T_max, tau_max) makes it bind -- a binding certification needs a DIFFERENT functional form (plan/state-conditional), which trades coverage for tightness.
erratum.correction_2: for an already-loaded lot the correct segmented argument accumulates only the REMAINING decay from now to delivery (t_delivery - now <= tau_max), not the full in-cargo time; for a not-yet-picked order t_load >= now makes the same tau_max apply. This matches the code's Q_start choice.
